01 / SELECTED WORK

Ideas, turned into systems.

All repositories ↗

Analytics Platform

Events & analytics · Go backend
  • Collects application events and supports queries for page activity.
  • Uses API-key authentication and PostgreSQL to manage project records.
  • Combines ClickHouse analytics with Redis caching.
  • Go
  • PostgreSQL
  • ClickHouse
  • Redis

Notification Service

Queues & workers · TypeScript service
  • Validates incoming requests for asynchronous email delivery.
  • Queues email jobs with BullMQ and Redis.
  • Handles delivery in a separate worker, apart from the request flow.
  • TypeScript
  • Express
  • BullMQ
  • Redis

URL Shortener

APIs & caching · TypeScript API
  • Creates short links with NanoID and stores destinations in PostgreSQL.
  • Caches redirects in Redis.
  • Includes a Docker Compose setup for running the project locally.
  • TypeScript
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Docker
